summary: The PR adds the --skip-checks option to management commands, which resolves the issue as described. However, there are some minor style and consistency issues.

issues.description: The order of options in `base_stealth_options` was changed, but 'skip_checks' was removed. It should remain to maintain consistency with the existing stealth options handling.
The new option '--skip-checks' is added but there is no corresponding documentation update in the command-line help or any other relevant documentation.
